meta.title: Aikido pricing
meta.description: Aikido training prices in Mariánské Lázně. Adults 200 CZK/month, students 160 CZK/month. First three training sessions are free.

freeNote: The first three training sessions are free!
freeSubnote: Come try aikido with no commitment whatsoever.
note: Fees are used to cover the cost of gym rental and equipment maintenance. We are a non-profit club and all contributions go back into the club's activities.
cta: Have a question about pricing? Contact us
